S2D4P.inference.predictors.cvae module

class S2D4P.inference.predictors.cvae.cVAEPredictor(config: cVAEPredictorConfig, module: moduleABC, distributed: Distributed, output_dir: Path | str, num_output_sampling: int = 1)

Bases: PredictorABC

Run inference for a conditional variational autoencoder.

Supports prior sampling, latent distributions estimated from training posteriors, output residual covariance sampling, latent-variable export, and temporary NetCDF prediction output.

Parameters:

  • config (cVAEPredictorConfig) – Configuration controlling latent sampling and output behavior.

  • module (moduleABC) – Trained cVAE module used for inference.

  • distributed (Distributed) – Distributed runtime used for device placement and rank information.

  • output_dir (Path | str) – Directory in which inference outputs and training statistics are stored.

  • num_output_sampling (int) – Number of output samples generated for each latent sample.

build_latent_sampler() → Callable[[...], Tensor]

Build a sampler from training posterior statistics.

The saved posterior mean and covariance matrix are loaded and used to create a callable that samples a multivariate latent distribution.

Returns:

Callable accepting a sample shape and standard-deviation multiplier and returning latent samples.

Return type:

Callable[…, torch.Tensor]

Raises:

ValueError – If training statistics have not been saved or the stored statistics do not contain posterior sample mean and covariance values.

class S2D4P.inference.predictors.cvae.cVAEPredictorConfig(num_latent_samples: int, nstds: float = 1.0, chunk_size: int | None = None, infer_latent_samples_from_training: bool = False, save_latent: bool = False)

Bases: object

Configuration for conditional variational autoencoder inference.

Parameters:

  • num_latent_samples (int) – Number of latent samples generated for each input sample.

  • nstds (float) – Standard-deviation multiplier used when sampling latent variables.

  • chunk_size (int | None) – Number of latent samples processed per generation chunk. If None, all latent samples are processed together.

  • infer_latent_samples_from_training (bool) – Whether latent samples are drawn from a Gaussian distribution estimated from posterior samples collected on the training data.

  • save_latent (bool) – Whether latent variables are saved instead of model predictions.

final add_decoder_noise(output: OutputABC, num_output_samples: int, sample_size: tuple, reshape_size: tuple) → OutputABC

Add covariance-sampled noise to decoder predictions.

A residual sampler is built lazily from saved training statistics. Independent noise samples are reshaped to the model output dimensions and added to the prediction tensor.

Parameters:

  • output (OutputABC) – Model output whose prediction tensor is perturbed.

  • num_output_samples (int) – Number of noisy output samples to generate.

  • sample_size (tuple) – Leading sample dimensions used when drawing residual noise.

  • reshape_size (tuple) – Output dimensions into which each sampled residual vector is reshaped.

Returns:

Model output with its prediction tensor replaced by the sampled output ensemble.

Return type:

OutputABC

final build_output_sampler() → Callable[[...], Tensor]

Build an output-noise sampler from training residual statistics.

The saved residual covariance is used to construct a zero-mean multivariate distribution for stochastic perturbation of model outputs.

Returns:

Callable accepting a sample shape and returning residual noise samples.

Return type:

Callable[…, torch.Tensor]

Raises:

ValueError – If training-derived statistics have not been saved.

S2D4P.inference.predictors.predictor_abc.save_batch_to_netcdf(prediction: Tensor, metadata: list[dict], num_output_dims: int, save_name: str, save_dir: str | Path, extra_dims_sorted: list[str] | None = None, assign_coords: dict | None = None, attrs: dict | None = None)

Save a batch of model predictions to NetCDF.

Prediction tensors are converted to an xarray DataArray with explicit sample, channel, and output dimensions. Per-sample metadata are represented as a MultiIndex and unstacked into coordinate dimensions before saving.

Parameters:

  • prediction (torch.Tensor) – Prediction tensor containing optional leading sample dimensions followed by batch, channel, and model output dimensions.

  • metadata (list[dict]) – Per-sample coordinate metadata. Each dictionary must contain the same coordinate fields.

  • num_output_dims (int) – Number of model output dimensions, including the channel dimension.

  • save_name (str) – Filename of the NetCDF output.

  • save_dir (str | Path) – Directory in which the NetCDF file is written.

  • extra_dims_sorted (list[str] | None) – Names assigned to leading prediction dimensions, such as "output_samples" or "latent_samples".

  • assign_coords (dict | None) – Additional coordinates assigned to the resulting DataArray.

  • attrs (dict | None) – Attributes attached to the resulting DataArray.

Raises:

ValueError – If the prediction tensor has an unexpected number of dimensions or the metadata length does not match the prediction batch size.
